user.title: OBD-II Bluetooth (ELM327)
user.description:
1. Turn the vehicle ignition ON so the adapter wakes up.
2. If the adapter has a pairing button, press it.
3. Submit. Home Assistant scans Bluetooth Classic for about 12 seconds.

select.title: Select the adapter
select.description: Pick your OBD adapter. Already-paired adapters are listed too. To scan again, submit with nothing selected.

pair.title: Pair and test
pair.description:
Make sure the ignition is on (and press the adapter's pairing button if it has one), then submit. Home Assistant will pair, open the serial link, and query the adapter.

Last error: {detail}

error.none_found: No Classic Bluetooth devices found. Make sure the ignition is on and the adapter is in pairing mode, then submit to scan again.
error.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Put the adapter in pairing mode and try again.
error.connect_failed: Paired, but the serial (SPP) link didn't open. Make sure the adapter is awake and try again.
error.rfcomm_missing: This system's Bluetooth stack can't open serial (RFCOMM) links, so a direct connection isn't possible on this install.
error.no_response: The link opened but the adapter didn't answer AT commands.

abort.already_configured: This adapter is already set up.
